# gawkbot

> gawkbot is the open source Grok Bot. It is two things at once. It is an inbox: every coding agent on your Mac, and the ones in the cloud, asks you from the Mac notch or your iPhone, and you answer with a key, a tap or your voice. It is also a multi-agent harness: the agents become a team run by a Chief of Staff, which hands out tasks; bots work together, run routines on a schedule, keep a wiki of what they learn with every claim cited, and build microapps so you can use the outcome. Free, runs on your machine with Claude Code, Codex, Opencode, or a local model, and every action through your connected accounts waits for your approval.

gawkbot is an independent, source-available project under the Sustainable Use License. It is a parody of xAI's Grok Bot and is not affiliated with xAI, X Corp, or Cursor.

## Key facts

- Install: download the Mac app from https://gawk.bot/download.html (a signed .dmg from GitHub Releases) and build the iPhone app from `apps/ios`; needs Claude Code, Codex CLI, or Opencode signed in
- Price: free, no account, no gawkbot cloud service, no seats, no usage fees
- Runs on: your machine, with your keys; local models keep everything offline
- Models: Claude Code (default), Codex CLI, Opencode, local models, Hermes Bot, OpenClaw
- Bot computers: each bot gets a sandbox on your machine or a cloud computer, with its own directory and tool allowlist
- Inbox: every agent's questions and approvals land in the Mac notch (a pill on Macs without one) and in the iPhone app; answer with one key, a tap or your voice
- Team: a Chief of Staff breaks work into tasks and hands them to bots, who claim them, review each other's work and report back
- Routines: a bot's prompt runs on a schedule, with versioned prompts and a transcript per run; the runner is the agent/ service in the repo, run from a source checkout
- Knowledge: the bots write and maintain a wiki, with every claim cited back to its source
- Microapps: bots build small apps over workspace data, sandboxed inside gawkbot
- Approvals: per action on every external write, never a blanket grant
- Platforms: Mac app with an iPhone companion; the open-source web app can be built from source on other systems
- Licence: Sustainable Use License (read, modify, self-host; do not resell as a hosted product)
